## Purpose and runtime
Thunderbird for iOS is an early-stage native email client. The production application is a Swift/SwiftUI iOS app, assembled through the Xcode workspace/project at `Thunderbird.xcworkspace` and `Thunderbird/Thunderbird.xcodeproj`. Its app entry point is `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/App.swift`, which leads into the root UI in `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/ContentView.swift`.

## Application composition
The UI target is organized around mail-client workflows rather than a server backend:
- App shell, navigation, welcome state, and account-aware root content: `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/App.swift`, `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/ContentView.swift`, `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/WelcomeScreen.swift`.
- Account and mailbox navigation: `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/Account/AccountsView.swift`, `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/AccountList/DrawerView.swift`.
- Reading and composing presentation: `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/EmailDisplay/EmailListView.swift`, `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/EmailDisplay/ReadEmailView.swift`, `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/ComposeView/ComposeView.swift`.
- Settings and rollout controls: `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/Settings/GeneralSettingsView.swift`, `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/FeatureFlags/FeatureFlags.swift`.

## Core domain boundary
`Core` is a separate Swift Package containing the reusable mail domain and protocol implementation, declared in `Core/Package.swift`. The account layer models identities, credentials, servers, mailboxes, folders, emails, and manager abstractions: `Core/Sources/Account/Account.swift`, `Core/Sources/Account/AccountManager.swift`, `Core/Sources/Account/EmailManager.swift`. This is the principal boundary between SwiftUI screens and mail-provider/network details.

## Account onboarding and discovery
Account setup UI gathers account details, chooses account type, invokes automatic discovery, or allows manual server setup: `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/Account/AddAccountView.swift`, `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/Account/AccountAuth/EmailAccountTypeSelection.swift`, `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/Account/AccountAuth/ManualServerSetup.swift`. Discovery in Core parses domains, resolves DNS/SRV information, obtains provider configurations, and supports OAuth2: `Core/Sources/Autoconfiguration/ClientConfig.swift`, `Core/Sources/Autoconfiguration/DNSResolver.swift`, `Core/Sources/Autoconfiguration/OAuth2.swift`. External dependencies are email-provider configuration endpoints, DNS, and OAuth authorization/token services.

## Mail protocols and data flow
Configured server/account data selects protocol-specific clients:
- IMAP provides mailbox/message retrieval and mutation commands, capability handling, and idle events: `Core/Sources/IMAP/IMAPClient.swift`, `Core/Sources/IMAP/FetchCommand.swift`, `Core/Sources/IMAP/IdleHandler.swift`.
- JMAP provides HTTP session discovery and batched method requests for accounts, mailboxes, emails, and threads: `Core/Sources/JMAP/JMAPClient.swift`, `Core/Sources/JMAP/Session.swift`, `Core/Sources/JMAP/Method.swift`.
- SMTP sends outbound messages through request encoding and response/send handlers: `Core/Sources/SMTP/SMTPClient.swift`, `Core/Sources/SMTP/RequestEncoder.swift`, `Core/Sources/SMTP/SendHandler.swift`.

The expected flow is UI action → Account manager/domain model → selected IMAP/JMAP/SMTP client → remote mail service → normalized account/email/mailbox models → SwiftUI display.

## Message representation and presentation
MIME parsing represents RFC-style headers, bodies, multipart boundaries, encodings, and attachments: `Core/Sources/MIME/Part.swift`, `Core/Sources/MIME/Body.swift`, `Core/Sources/MIME/Header.swift`. Account email models bridge this data toward display and composition: `Core/Sources/Account/Email.swift`, `Core/Sources/Account/EmailBody.swift`, `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/EmailDisplay/EmailBodyView.swift`.

## Supporting packages and delivery
`Bolt` is a separate Swift package providing shared SwiftUI design-system primitives: `Bolt/Package.swift`, `Bolt/Sources/BoltUI/BoltDesignSystem.swift`, `Bolt/Sources/Bolt/BoltUI.swift`. App localization is bundled in `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/Localization`, and feature behavior can vary by distribution: `Thunderbird/Thunderbird/FeatureFlags/Distribution.swift`. CI runs tests/security checks via GitHub Actions, while iOS release automation is in `fastlane/Fastfile`; Xcode Cloud metadata is under `Thunderbird/Thunderbird.xcodeproj/xcshareddata/xcodecloud/manifest.json`.
